# Handle invalid work results count

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

This PR explicitly handles invalid count of work results.
While we do this during decoding of JSON and BIN and reject such decoding,
this is not done during regular transition, when a view is received.
It was only failing after we attempted to materialize the guarantee that contained invalid work report.

Introduced:
- [x] Explicit check on work report view and explicit rejection
- [x] Making fuzzing target more robust by catching exceptions and returning an error instead of crashing
- [x] binary state transition tests are using `BlockView` now to be able to reproduce similar issues in the future

## Walkthrough

This pull request refactors block handling throughout the codebase by replacing encode/decode round-trip patterns with direct materialization via `.materialize()` methods. The StateTransition API is updated to use BlockView instead of Block, and a new `blockViewFromJson()` function is added to support JSON deserialization into view representations. Additionally, work items count validation is introduced through a new `isWorkItemsCount()` type guard and corresponding error type, with validation checks added to the reports verification logic. Error handling in the fuzz protocol handler is improved with try/catch wrappers and structured error messages.

- **FluffyLabs/typeberry#665** — Both update bin/convert/types.ts to change fuzz-message and block processing paths using materialized representations instead of encode/decode steps.
